highlights: In a Telegram group that you connected before this version, remove OpenBot from the group and connect the group again, or make OpenBot a group admin.
Settings › Notifications is now one table: choose All activity, Only when it needs me, or Nothing for each server and agent, on all your devices.
Create more servers on this computer, each a separate workspace with its own agents, chats and files.
In a channel, more than one agent can now answer the same request.
Connect your own OpenAI-compatible voice server for dictation and spoken replies, and Gemini no longer fills the memory of a server.
